tbesh_html:
A man living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.7.25
§ Oreb = "raven"
1) one of the chieftains of the Midianite army defeated by Gideon
2) a rock east of the Jordan where Oreb and part of his army fell to the Ephraimites

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Oreb, the name of a Midianite and of the cliff near the Jordan
strongs_1890.derivation: or עוֹרֵב; the same as H6158 (עֹרֵב);
